definitions.gloss: manju, steamed bun with sweet filling
definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese confection consisting of a wheat or rice flour outer layer filled with sweet bean paste (anko).

notes:
{饅頭|まんじゅう} is a classic Japanese sweet with Chinese origins.

Types:
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう} (hot spring manju) - brown, common souvenir
- ⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう} (red and white) - for celebrations
- ⟦{薄皮|うすかわ}→薄皮：28916_usukawa⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう} (thin-skinned)
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう} (sake-flavored dough)
- ⟦{葛|くず}→葛：noentry⟧{饅頭|まんじゅう} (kudzu starch wrapper)

Filling:
- Usually ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧ (sweet bean paste)
- ⟦こし{餡|あん}→こし餡：20791_koshian⟧ (smooth) or ⟦{粒餡|つぶあん}→粒餡：20790_tsubuan⟧ (chunky)

Cultural significance:
- Popular souvenir item (⟦{お土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧)
- Given at weddings, celebrations (⟦{紅白|こうはく}→紅白：13805_kouhaku⟧)
- Associated with Buddhist temples (original purpose)

Phrases:
- 「{饅頭|まんじゅう}⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧」- from a famous rakugo story
